header.title: Built for your
header.description: Powerful tools designed to bring bookings, payments, operations, and customer management together in one simple platform.

items.title: Online Bookings
items.desc: Make booking simple. Give customers an easy way to discover your venue, choose a session, and book online.

items.title: Venue Management
items.desc: Run everything in one place. Manage your venue, customers, sessions, availability, and day-to-day operations.

items.title: OrbetPOS™
items.desc: Your venue, ready to sell. Manage in-venue sales, products, payments, and customer transactions with ease.

items.title: OrbetKDS™
items.desc: Keep every order moving. Send food and drink orders straight to your kitchen and keep your team in sync.

items.title: Reporting & Analytics
items.desc: See how your venue performs. Understand bookings, sales, customers, and revenue with clear reporting.

items.title: OrbetPay™
items.desc: Payments made simple. Take secure payments online and in venue while keeping everything connected to Orbet.
